title: Add secretx workspace dependencies (crates.io, v0.3.0)
description: Why: All per-crate secretx integration tasks depend on the workspace resolving the secretx crates. secretx 0.3.0 is now published on crates.io — use registry deps, not a local path. What to do: In the root Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies], add: secretx-core = { version = '0.3.0' } and secretx = { version = '0.3.0', default-features = false, features = ['env', 'file'] }. Add additional backend features (aws-sm, aws-kms, pkcs11) as separate optional workspace deps for consuming crates that need them. Consuming crates (stoa-transit, stoa-reader, stoa-auth) reference via { workspace = true } in their own Cargo.toml. Verify cargo build --workspace compiles cleanly. No local path = '../crate-secretsx/...' entries — use the registry.
notes: secretx 0.3.0 published on crates.io. Replaces stoa-31d0c78a (which was the old crates.io publication gate — now closed). Once this is done, unblocks: stoa-c0b7a31e, stoa-5cde2362, stoa-7271458c, stoa-6a99b937, stoa-2eb3f01c, stoa-644cbdd8, stoa-a6cbd038.
